reason: This passage (Exodus 32) describes an internal religious disciplinary action following the Golden Calf incident. The Hebrews are not fighting against a foreign enemy or external adversary for territorial control or national independence. Rather, Moses commands the Levites to execute judgment against fellow Israelites who participated in idolatry, enforcing covenant loyalty to God. The conflict is internal (within the Hebrew community) and religious (covenant violation), not a military campaign for national sovereignty over land against external forces.
